# Data Table - Store - Dispatcher Actions

## Dispatcher Actions

**Store Action**:

| Property | Type | Required | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sort` | `{ sort: SortState \| null }` | no | Apply a sort to the data table. | `actions.sort({ sort: { key: "name", field: "name", direction: "asc" } })` |
| `sortDone` | `{ sort: SortState \| null }` | no | Emitted when a sort has been applied. | `actions.sortDone({ sort: { key: "name", field: "name", direction: "asc" } })` |
| `setFilter` | `{ key: string; filter: FilterExpression \| null }` | no | Set or clear one column filter. | `actions.setFilter({ key: "name", filter: { field: "name", operator: "Contains", values: { value: "test" } }, })` |
| `setFilterDone` | `{ key: string; filter: FilterExpression \| null }` | no | Emitted when a column filter has been applied. | `actions.setFilterDone({ key: "name", filter: { field: "name", operator: "Contains", values: { value: "test" } }, })` |
| `clearFilters` | `{}` | no | Clear all active filters. | `actions.clearFilters()` |
| `clearFiltersDone` | `{}` | no | Emitted when all filters have been cleared. | `actions.clearFiltersDone()` |
| `setConstraint` | `{ key: string; filter: FilterExpression \| null; scrollBehavior?: "top" \| "preserve" }` | no | Set or lift an ambient constraint, ANDed onto the user's filters without becoming one of them: no chip, no dialog, no persistence, and clearFilters leaves it standing. Keyed by source, so each is lifted independently. It has an effect only if the data engine applies the constraints its setFilters receives: arrayData, dataSourceData, dataStoreData and pagedApiCallData do; asyncData does not (fetchRows gets only the user's filter), and a custom engine must read constraints itself. | `actions.setConstraint({ key: "mapViewportSync", filter: { field: "state", operator: "Equal", values: { value: "FL" } }, })` |
| `setConstraintDone` | `{ key: string; filter: FilterExpression \| null; scrollBehavior?: "top" \| "preserve" }` | no | Emitted when a constraint has been applied or lifted. | `actions.setConstraintDone({ key: "mapViewportSync", filter: { field: "state", operator: "Equal", values: { value: "FL" } }, })` |
| `integrations/enable` | `{ key: string }` | no | Start the integration with this key. Dispatch it as actions.enableIntegration({ key }). Also runs a refresh pass (rows re-read from the data engine, table scrolled to the top). | `actions.enableIntegration({ key: "mapViewportSync" })` |
| `integrations/disable` | `{ key: string }` | no | Stop the integration with this key, running its cleanup. Dispatch it as actions.disableIntegration({ key }). The table dispatches it too when an integration fails to start, so subscribing keeps your own controls honest. Also runs a refresh pass (rows re-read from the data engine, table scrolled to the top). | `actions.disableIntegration({ key: "mapViewportSync" })` |
| `rows/applyInsert` | `{ atIndex: GlobalRowIndex; row: UnknownObject }` | no | Synchronously insert a row into the segment cache. No persistence - use store.mutations.insert() when you need that. The table then refreshes, re-reading every loaded segment from the data engine and scrolling to the top, so the inserted row stays only if the data engine returns it. | `actions.rowsApplyInsert({ atIndex: toGlobalRowIndex(0), row: { id: 2, name: "new row" }, })` |
| `rows/applyUpdate` | `{ rowIndex: GlobalRowIndex; row: UnknownObject; fields: readonly string[] }` | no | Synchronously replace a row in the segment cache; pass the complete row. No persistence - use store.mutations.update() when you need that. A partial row blanks every other cell, and there is no refresh. Build it as { ...store.getRow(rowIndex), status: "retired" }. fields only names what changed. | `actions.rowsApplyUpdate({ rowIndex: toGlobalRowIndex(0), row: { ...store.getRow(0), name: "updated" }, fields: ["name"], })` |
| `rows/applyRemove` | `{ rowIndex: GlobalRowIndex }` | no | Synchronously remove a row from the segment cache. No persistence - use store.mutations.remove() when you need that. The table then refreshes, re-reading every loaded segment from the data engine and scrolling to the top, so the row comes back unless the data engine removed it too. | `actions.rowsApplyRemove({ rowIndex: toGlobalRowIndex(0), })` |
| `rows/update` | `{ rowIndex: GlobalRowIndex; row: UnknownObject; fields: readonly string[] }` | no | Internal: used by cell edits to trigger the data engine's updateRow. Dispatches rows/update/done or rows/update/failed when complete. | `actions.rowsUpdate({ rowIndex: toGlobalRowIndex(0), row: { id: 1, name: "updated" }, fields: ["name"], })` |
| `rows/update/done` | `{ rowIndex: GlobalRowIndex; row: UnknownObject; fields: readonly string[] }` | no | Emitted when a cell-edit row update succeeds. | `actions.rowsUpdateDone({ rowIndex: toGlobalRowIndex(0), row: { id: 1, name: "updated" }, fields: ["name"], })` |
| `rows/update/failed` | `{ rowIndex: GlobalRowIndex; row: UnknownObject; error: unknown }` | no | Emitted when a cell-edit row update fails. | `actions.rowsUpdateFailed({ rowIndex: toGlobalRowIndex(0), row: { id: 1, name: "updated" }, error: new Error("update failed"), })` |
| `cells/update` | `{ rowIndex: GlobalRowIndex; key: string; value: unknown }` | no | Synchronously patch a single cell value in the cache (value cells only). It sets one property of a loaded cached row and repaints it, without saving and without a refresh. key is the row field to set (a data column's field, not its column key); nothing happens when the row is not loaded. | `actions.cellsUpdate({ rowIndex: toGlobalRowIndex(0), key: "name", value: "updated", })` |
| `refresh` | `{}` | no | Trigger a full data table refresh pass. | `actions.refresh()` |
| `persist` | `{}` | no | Persist current state via the configured persistence engine. | `actions.persist()` |
| `clearStorage` | `{}` | no | Clear persisted data table state. Only the layout saved by the persistence engine is cleared; the sort, filters and widths in memory are unchanged. Also runs a refresh pass (rows re-read from the data engine, table scrolled to the top). | `actions.clearStorage()` |
| `resetGrid` | `{}` | no | Reset data table state to defaults. Sort, filters, column order, widths and visibility go back to the table's defaults (constraints stay), and the saved layout is cleared. Headers, formatters and display units also go back to what the table declares, and the selection, any edit in progress and hide-empty-columns are cleared. | `actions.resetGrid()` |
| `setVisibleRange` | `{ start: number; count: number }` | no | Update the visible row window. It stores start and count as the view state's visibleRange; it does not scroll the table to that window. To bring a row into view, dispatch selectCell with scrollIntoView: true. The rows shown follow the scroll position, and the action runs a refresh pass that scrolls to the top. | `actions.setVisibleRange({ start: 0, count: 50, })` |
| `setColumnVisibility` | `{ key: string; visible: boolean }` | no | Update visibility for a single column. | `actions.setColumnVisibility({ key: "name", visible: false, })` |
| `setColumnVisibilities` | `{ changes: ReadonlyArray<{ key: string; visible: boolean }> }` | no | Update visibility for multiple columns at once. | `actions.setColumnVisibilities({ changes: [ { key: "name", visible: false }, { key: "region", visible: true }, ], })` |
| `setColumnWidth` | `{ key: string; width: Pixels }` | no | Set width for a specific column key. It is not saved: dispatch actions.persist() afterwards if it should be remembered. The width is applied by a refresh pass (rows re-read from the data engine, table scrolled to the top). | `actions.setColumnWidth({ key: "name", width: toPixels(180), })` |
| `hideEmptyColumns` | `{}` | no | Ask the empty-column engine which columns are empty, then hide the visible ones among them. Emits hideEmptyColumns/done with the hidden keys, or hideEmptyColumns/failed. | `actions.hideEmptyColumns()` |
| `hideEmptyColumnsDone` | `{ keys: ReadonlyArray<string> }` | no | Emitted by the effect with the keys it hid. Dispatched for you; subscribe to it rather than dispatching it. | `actions.hideEmptyColumnsDone({ keys: ["notes", "region"], })` |
| `showEmptyColumns` | `{}` | no | Restore the columns hideEmptyColumns hid, leaving any column the user hid alone. Emits showEmptyColumns/done with the restored keys. | `actions.showEmptyColumns()` |
| `showEmptyColumnsDone` | `{ keys: ReadonlyArray<string> }` | no | Emitted by the effect with the keys it restored. Dispatched for you; subscribe to it rather than dispatching it. | `actions.showEmptyColumnsDone({ keys: ["notes", "region"], })` |
| `loadSegments` | `{}` | no | Load missing row segments. | `actions.loadSegments()` |
| `loadSegmentsDone` | `{}` | no | Emitted when missing row segments have been loaded. | `actions.loadSegmentsDone()` |
| `restoreState` | `{ sort?: SortState; filters?: Record<string, FilterExpression> }` | no | Restore sort and filters from saved state. | `actions.restoreState({ sort: { key: "name", field: "name", direction: "asc" }, filters: { name: { field: "name", operator: "Contains", values: { value: "test" } }, }, })` |
| `updateFlattenedFilters` | `{ key: string; flattenedFilters: FlattenedFilterCondition[] }` | no | Update flattened filter conditions for a column. Internal to the filter dialog: stores the unsaved condition rows the open dialog shows for a column. It filters nothing; use setFilter to filter a column, and do not dispatch this from your own code. | `actions.updateFlattenedFilters({ key: "name", flattenedFilters: [], })` |
| `selectCell` | `{ selection: SelectionState; scrollIntoView?: boolean }` | no | Update active cell/selection state. | `actions.selectCell({ selection: { coordinates: { row: toGlobalRowIndex(0), column: toActiveColumnIndex(0) }, selectionMode: "cell", }, scrollIntoView: true, })` |
| `startEdit` | `{ rowIndex: GlobalRowIndex; columnKey: string; trigger: EditTrigger }` | no | Begin editing a cell. The column must be visible and editable with an editor for the same trigger (by default dblclick, enter and contextMenu), and the row must be loaded; otherwise only a console warning appears. | `actions.startEdit({ rowIndex: toGlobalRowIndex(0), columnKey: "name", trigger: "dblclick", })` |
| `commitEdit` | `{ newValue: unknown }` | no | Commit the current in-progress cell edit. | `actions.commitEdit({ newValue: "updated" })` |
| `cancelEdit` | `{}` | no | Cancel the current in-progress cell edit. | `actions.cancelEdit()` |
| `reapplyThemes` | `{ kind?: "all" \| "rows" \| "cells" \| "headers" \| "columns"; columnKeys?: readonly string[]; globalRowIndexes?: readonly GlobalRowIndex[] }` | no | Force re-evaluation of visible theme callbacks. Use when an external value that a callback closes over has changed. Defaults to "all". | `actions.reapplyThemes({ kind: "cells", columnKeys: ["name", "region"], })` |
